features.missing_rule: Require 64 exact 8h close boundaries; never bridge or impute.
features.transform: price admissibility only: one-bar/tail return, drawdown, log range, and annualized volatility

features.availability_rule: Available with the same closed candle.
features.missing_rule: Require finite nonnegative values and at least 80% positive observations.
features.transform: price-history admissibility only; never an alpha rank

features.availability_rule: Use only funding_time strictly before decision_time and no earlier than 14 days before it.
features.missing_rule: Require at least 12 unique finite events, a latest event no older than 24h, and no absolute event rate above 0.01; exclude rather than impute.
features.source: DecisionContext.funding for an A6-authorized eligible symbol
features.transform: cumulative funding transfer plus 0.30 times sign-persistence-weighted absolute transfer over the trailing 14 days

features.availability_rule: Computed only at the 168h Unix-epoch-anchored schedule after price and funding admissibility.
features.lag: inherits strictly past closed candles and funding events
features.missing_rule: Capture one empty dict and flatten below 10 scored coins; flatten after capture for spread below 0.75 or insufficient four-per-side scores beyond +/-0.25.
features.transform: negative robust z-score of funding pressure, exposed once through strategy.score_boundary before spread filtering, selection, retention, sizing, caps, or organizer risk

forbidden_inputs: tokenized or synthetic TradFi securities, commodities, metals, or indexes
funding events at or after decision_time
transaction opens before A5 label construction
positions, equity, fills, PnL, results, private qualifier, or OOS data
universe_authority: Amendment 0006 metadata-qualified eligible_symbols only; quote/collateral denomination does not classify the base asset.
